'''Tunneling Nidwyrm''' is an [[Advanced enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A creature that spews highly corrosive fluids. Nidwyrms usually live underground. They would dissolve metallic materials with acids before consuming them. Nidwyrm hunters are therefore advised to take proper care of their weapons.}}

==Overview==
As wildlife creatures that comes from underground, Tunneling Nidwyrms are known for their immobility yet having attacks that serve them for close or far range combat:

*Swings their head around, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back.
*Thrusts their head onto the ground, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back in an area.
*Spits and deals Nature damage.
*Spits three times in a row. The spits upon landing create poisonous zones that deal Nature damage to Operators on them. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
